relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin acts as an agonist to transient receptor potential vanilloid (TRPV) 1, which is a non-selective cation channel

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin, through TRPV1, exerts an endothelial protective action, inducing the release of nitric oxide (NO) and calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP).

key_findings: Review: capsaicin activates TRPV1 and with continued application desensitizes sensory fibers, giving pain relief.
Topical capsaicin relieved pain in five patients with post-traumatic trigeminal neuropathy.
